messages:
sara-support: Thornfield reporting intermittent p99 spikes (~5-10x baseline) starting ~10:20 UTC, mostly on /embeddings endpoint. Customer says it affects some batches but not all. Any quick mitigations before we escalate?

jordan-cs: On it — I asked for sample request IDs and they sent rId: th-9f2b3. They see it in us-west and eu-west. They said spike correlates with large batch jobs (~5k vectors).

mike-oncall: Looking at infra: queue depth on gpu-pool-3 jumped, p99 ~12s last 15m. Host-level CPU steal and a few long-running dedup jobs on the same shard. Suspect noisy neighbor + shard affinity churn.

lee-sre: Any recent rollouts to serving runtime or kernel updates? Querying routing logs now.

lee-sre: (snippet from routing logs)
```
2026-03-17T10:18:02Z route: tenant=thornfield => shard=7
2026-03-17T10:18:05Z route: tenant=thornfield => shard=3 fallback (shard 7 overloaded)
2026-03-17T10:19:44Z request rId=th-9f2b3 latency=11234ms host=gpu-node-3
```

tanya-eng: Short-term options: 1) soft per-tenant throttle (limit bursts) 2) ephemeral reservation on quieter shard (1h) to pin affinity 3) enable prefix/KV caching for their common prompts. I can push an admin reservation; example curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/reservations \
  -d '{"tenant":"thornfield","duration_mins":60,"shard_hint":"shard-11","type":"ephemeral"}' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN'
```

mike-oncall: I'll apply a precautionary throttle (10 qps) and create an ephemeral reservation. Applying now.

mike-oncall: Applied throttle=10 qps for tenant=thornfield and reservation res-439 on shard-11. Observed p99 drop to ~1.1s in the last 3m after shift. Monitoring 30m. :thumbsup:

sara-support: Customer agreed to the temporary throttle (they're in a degraded-but-acceptable state). They asked what a permanent fix would look like and if priority lanes are possible.

lee-sre: Follow-ups: 1) Analyze their token size distribution and batch sizes (5k vectors is big; interleaving could help). 2) Consider moving them to Dedicated or a reserved shard for stable latency. 3) Check eviction/caching parameters — their repeated large batches might benefit from a short KV cache TTL. I'll open an SRE ticket to dig deeper.

jordan-cs: I'll put together a short proposal: Dedicated vs reserved ephemeral reservations cost estimate + expected p99 improvements. Also will draft KB for ephemeral reservations and when to use them.

ops-bot: reservation res-439 created by mike-oncall at 1760000200 (ephemeral, shard-11, duration=60m)

sara-support: Thanks team. Customer will hold with the throttle while we investigate. Closing thread if stable, will reopen if spikes recur.
